assertion.statement: The actual X1(N) used for J has a Belyi map of degree at most N^2.
assertion.objects: The earlier J=J1(N), A/Lprime and complementary Z with original exponent24 height budget.
assertion.hypotheses: N>=11 and the usual modular projection. No assertion about arbitrary curves of this genus. Javanpeykar and stable-height metric are separate reviewed inputs.
assertion.quantifiers: For each actual constructed object satisfying these explicitly retained premises.
assertion.parameter_range: The earlier J=J1(N), A/Lprime and complementary Z with original exponent24 height budget.
assertion.uniformity: No assertion about arbitrary curves of this genus. Javanpeykar and stable-height metric are separate reviewed inputs.
assertion.normalizations: Normalize the cusp and elliptic branch values to 0,1,infinity.
assertion.exceptional_cases: No assertion about arbitrary curves of this genus. Javanpeykar and stable-height metric are separate reviewed inputs.
assertion.limit_order: Normalize the at-most-three branch values of the standard projection to X(1)=P1 to 0,1,infinity. The sharper N^2/2 degree bound implies N^2. The separate genus and Javanpeykar inputs then imply the deliberately weaker 13000000 N^12 height bound.

before.reason: Normalize the at-most-three branch values of the standard projection to X(1)=P1 to 0,1,infinity. The sharper N^2/2 degree bound implies N^2. The separate genus and Javanpeykar inputs then imply the deliberately weaker 13000000 N^12 height bound.

supplier.statement: Section4 proves deg_B X(Gamma)<=d_Gamma, and d_Gamma<=N^2/2 for Gamma1(N), N>=11.
